description: Source code implementing directory iteration functions for a Git-related project, including directory traversal, sorting, and resource management.

methods.name: next_directory_entry
methods.description: Reads the next directory entry, skipping '.' and '..'.

methods.name: push_level
methods.description: Pushes a new directory level onto the iteration stack, opening the directory and optionally sorting entries.

methods.name: pop_level
methods.description: Removes the top directory level from the stack, closing the directory and freeing resources.

methods.name: prepare_next_entry_data
methods.description: Prepares the data for the next directory entry, updating path and stat info.

methods.name: dir_iterator_begin
methods.description: Initializes a directory iterator for a given path with specified flags.
